summary: Phase 149O.20F -- HMIC v1.2 HBDC 25-File / 5-Contract Production Identity Alignment: NARROW PRODUCTION IDENTITY ALIGNMENT ONLY. Initial inspection confirmed repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.20E completed/pushed, pcae health/check/status-coherence/push-check/runtime-inspect/notify-status all as expected. Read the HMIC-001 contract (HMIC-REQ-050/052-053/067-069/145 directly), the HBDC-001 contract, and both 149O.20E/149O.20D.1 phase documents. Independently, mechanically re-extracted the live contract target: HMIC-REQ-050's fenced enumeration is exactly 25 entries; HMIC-REQ-067's contract_versions set is exactly 5 members {HMRC-001, HATP-001, HSCE-001, RAE-001, HBDC-001}. Independently re-extracted current production: _FROZEN_AUTHORITY_BEARING_FILES was exactly 24, _CONTRACT_IDENTITY_FILES was exactly 4 -- confirmed the exact +1/+1 delta (HBDC-001's document / HBDC-001 contract ID), no other divergence. Edited core/hatp_mandatory_certification.py only: widened _FROZEN_REPOSITORY_ROOT_RELATIVE_FILES (5 to 6 entries, inserting the HBDC-001 document immediately before the admin script, matching the contract's own presentation order exactly), widened the count assertion 24 to 25, and widened _CONTRACT_IDENTITY_FILES (4 to 5 entries, appending the HBDC-001 tuple using the identical representation as the other four -- no HBDC-specific parsing branch). Updated only the module-level comments describing these same constants (module docstring, block comments directly above the tuples) -- confirmed via an AST-based whole-module sweep that zero function or class bodies changed a single byte this phase (zero exceptions, including three docstrings deliberately left stale and disclosed as a minor, non-blocking documentation gap to preserve that zero-exception guarantee). Confirmed HBDC-001's dual binding empirically against production's own live functions (not a scratch reimplementation only): a same-version, content-only mutation of the HBDC-001 document changes implementation_scope_digest; a version-header bump changes the derived contract_versions["HBDC-001"] value; a malformed/renamed Contract-ID header raises ContractIdentityDerivationError (fail-closed); the four pre-existing bound contracts' own dual binding is unweakened by the addition. Confirmed all 25 live frozen files are individually digest-sensitive; confirmed the historical 24-file digest differs from the current 25-file digest for an identical snapshot (pre-20F replay rejected); confirmed production's own derive_implementation_scope_digest matches an independently authored reimplementation over the same live 25-file set (golden cross-check). Confirmed no caller-suppliable legacy 24-file/4-contract override parameter or language exists anywhere in production. Corrected a stale assumption in the governing phase instruction (its own item 3 requires this): re-derived from direct source inspection that production readiness is NOT hard-coded False as characterized -- a prior phase (Wave F, 149O.19.5F, independently confirmed closed at 149O.19.5E.4) already wired the HMIC validator into assess_hatp_mandatory_activation_readiness dynamically; hatp_mandatory_cutover.py itself remains byte-unchanged by this phase, and live readiness was empirically re-confirmed ready=False (no real Protected Root, repository-identity file, or certification state exists on this host). Widening production's live constants from 24/4 to 25/5 surfaced 36 test failures across 9 pre-existing historical phase test modules whose own assertions read production's state via a live (moving-reference) source read instead of their own fixed historical exit commit -- an antipattern this repository has repeatedly disclosed as repin-debt since 149O.19.5E.3. Repaired all 9 modules (test_phase_149o_19_5b/19_5e_3/19_5e_4/19_5f/19_5g/20c/20d/20d_1/20e), re-pinning each module's own historical claims to that module's own fixed exit commit via git-show-based helpers, and evolving two genuinely-live current-state suites (19_5b's own Wave B regression suite; 19_5g's one explicitly-documented live assertion) from 24/four to 25/five -- every original historical claim preserved exactly, none weakened, none rewritten, confirmed via a git-stash baseline re-run of the exact failing node-ID set before any of this phase's edits (0 still-new failures after repair). Wrote docs/PHASE_149O_20F_HMIC_V1_2_HBDC_25_FILE_5_CONTRACT_PRODUCTION_IDENTITY_ALIGNMENT.md and one new, independent test module, tests/test_phase_149o_20f_hmic_v1_2_hbdc_25_file_5_contract_production_identity_alignment.py (46 tests, all passed). Ran the full Fast Green suite (deselecting one pre-existing, environment-caused fido2-import collection error, confirmed via git stash to predate this phase): 71 failed, 6497 passed, 4 skipped, 25375 deselected at this phase's own final commit -- of the 71: 9 are working-tree-dirty checks (git status/diff against a moving HEAD, not a historical commit) that failed only while this phase's own edit was uncommitted and were confirmed to resolve (all 9 pass) once committed; 4 are a confirmed-spurious concurrent-task-lifecycle-state artifact in tests/test_backend_cli.py (reads live tasks/active/ state concurrently with this session's own pcae task new/update/close calls; confirmed passing 307/307 in isolation, matching this repository's own previously-documented gotcha); the remaining 58 are reproduced identically against this phase's own entry commit (43ecacb9) via git stash push -u, confirmed pre-existing and unrelated (contract-side HMIC-001 v1.1-to-v1.2 drift and long-standing unrelated failure clusters). Zero new HMIC/production regressions attributable to this phase. Exactly one production file modified (core/hatp_mandatory_certification.py, itself a frozen-set member); the other 24 previously-frozen files confirmed byte-unchanged since phase entry. Verdict: HMIC v1.2 HBDC PRODUCTION IDENTITY ALIGNMENT: IMPLEMENTED -- production now matches the verified 25-file/5-contract contract, HBDC dual binding present in production, independent implementation verification pending. B-149O.20D-1: contract defect closed, production repair implemented, independent implementation verification pending. HBDC-BINDING-GATE: production alignment implemented, independent implementation verification pending, NOT CLOSED. Class-B remains CONTRACT VERIFIED -- NOT PROVISIONED, unchanged.
